A warehouse has bins of capacities 7, 11, and 13 litres, initially empty. An unlimited tap and drain are available. Work through a rigorous way to measure exactly 5 litres. Explain each transfer, the state after each step, and why the method works. Then give a general breadth-first search algorithm for solving arbitrary capacities.
